entities.name: Columbus Sighting and Failed Settlement Attempts
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Columbus sighted the island in 1498, naming it 'Concepción' (later changed to 'Granada' by Spanish sailors). An English attempt at colonization in 1609 was repelled by the Caribs, as was a French attempt in 1638.
